name: @immediately-run/mdx-plugins
description: immediately.run's in-house remark plugins for the MDX safe subset (admonitions §12, wiki-links §13, heading/section-id anchors §15), the slug grammar (textSlug/sectionId), and the one frontmatter parser every corpus reader shares (parseFrontmatter, YAML 1.2 via `yaml`, on the `/frontmatter` subpath). The SINGLE source of truth shared byte-for-byte between the transpiler's compiled path and the SDK's non-executable safe renderer (TRUST_MODES §5.1 / R3-213), so the two render paths can't drift. The plugins are pure mdast transforms; the only runtime dependency is `yaml`, imported only by the `/frontmatter` subpath, so the root stays dependency-free.

scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run check:fixture && npm run check:llms && npm run lint
